author: Timmo2k10
quote:
Such a beautiful game and yet it fails in every way. This is not a GTA game it’s a modern red dead.

The story is so bland, and makes no sense. If there is a bad ending, then let us actually be bad and do all the things we would traditionally do in a GTA game… 

It just dangles cool looking things and never lets you actually do anything. All the side quests, fix this, workout are BORING. Why have you gave them the most inane controls, make it fun ffs.

13 years for one billion spent giving us a 30fps look at what it could’ve been. Rockstar shouldn’t be let off easy they have massively underdelivered, but the warnings were already in place when you see who is developing this game.

TLDR: if your going to try it, wait for the pc port and mods, not worth the slog just to look at good graphics.
